criteria.requirement: Repair tqdm_asyncio.as_completed to infer total only when len(fs) is supported. Accept standard asyncio.as_completed task generators under the pinned Python runtime, consume once through the real standard-library scheduler, use unknown total otherwise and preserve explicit total, empty input, timeout/cancellation/task errors and gather result-order behavior. Do not list() tasks solely to obtain a total or swallow non-TypeError length failures. All acceptance tasks use local asyncio.sleep(0), not network services or real accounts.
